alkylation_concentration.evidence: from wt and COSMC ko MDA‐MB‐231 secretomes in 4 M GuHCl, 250 mM HEPES pH 7.8 were reduced with 10 mM TCEP and alkylated with 40 mM CAA for 10 min
The reaction was quenched by reduction with 10 mM TCEP and alkylation with 40 mM CAA at 95°C for 10 min.
A total of 5 μg of human recombinant CD74 protein, expressed in HEK cells, was reduced with 10 mM TCEP and alkylated with 40 mM CAA for 10 min at 95°C.

Next, the cysteine residues of each sample were reduced by adding 3.5 mM tris‐(2‐carboxyethyl)‐phosphine (TCEP, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Roskilde, DK) and incubation for 45 min at 65°C, and then alkylated by adding 5 mM of chloroacetamide (CAA, Merck Life Science A/S, Søborg, DK) for 30 min at 65°C.
